player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Mastermind.
Yin ayei miɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ kuɔ̈t ee {code_length} kɔ̈ɔ̈c, kɔ̈ɔ̈c kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ ee 1 kuɔ̈t {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Yin ee kuɔ̈t, yin ayei miɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ kuɔ̈t ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ, yin ee nɔ̈ŋ kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ ee kuɔ̈t ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ.
Kuɔ̈t ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ, yin ee nɔ̈ŋ kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ.
Yin ee {max_turns} kuɔ̈t ee kuɔ̈t ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ.
player_prompt.with_repeats: kek lëu bï röt bɛɛr looi.
player_prompt.no_duplicates: cïn kë ye kek thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ thïn

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yïn akëc bɛ̈n bɛɛr ku ba nimirai cï tek yiic në thööŋ de nambaai.
invalid_move.not_integers: Kä ye kek gɔ̈ɔ̈r ëbën adhil ya nimirai ke path.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Kë ye yök adhil tɔ̈u në nimira {code_length} yic.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kä ye kek yök adhil tɔ̈u në kaam de 1 ku {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Akuɔ̈tnhïïm ye kek mat në nimirai kɔ̈k yiic aacïï ke puɔ̈l.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Yïn acï yök {guess}. Them dɛ̈t peei ba guic.

game_action.feedback: Aci looi [{guess}]. Nhial kuɔ̈ɔ̈t: {black_pegs} nhial kuɔ̈ɔ̈t ceŋ, {white_pegs} nhial kuɔ̈ɔ̈t yath.

outcome.win: Yin ee kuɔ̈t ee kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ, kuɔ̈t ee {black_pegs} kɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ ee {code_length} kɔ̈ɔ̈c
outcome.turn_limit: Ye kë ye yök ke cë rɔt waar. Yïn acï {percent}% de nimira yic them apath.
